text: etadavoca ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭhe va dhamme no parinibbāyanti . ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭhe va dhamme parinibbāyantīti . (yathā purimasuttantaṃ evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ) . pañcamaṃ . [200] ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme . atha kho ghosito gahapati yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami .pe. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho ghosito gahapati āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca dhātunānattaṃ dhātunānattanti bhante ānanda
